coverage_notes: The target paragraphs contain operative indemnity, claims-procedure, and payment/tax obligations, but none can be faithfully represented using the allowed activities. In particular, Charge is not a customer-to-provider payment action, and the allowed activities do not include indemnifying, defending, giving notice, controlling a claim, cooperating, consenting, or remitting taxes. No fictitious Use or other permission is added.

paragraph_audit.reason: Section 8.1 requires Mistral AI to indemnify, defend, and hold Customer harmless for qualifying third-party intellectual-property claims, subject to Section 8.2. These are operative obligations, but no allowed activity represents them.

Section 8.3 requires Customer to indemnify, defend, and hold Mistral AI and specified related parties harmless for claims arising from the stated causes. No allowed activity represents those obligations.

Section 8.4 imposes operative claim-notice, control, cooperation, and settlement-consent requirements on the indemnifying and indemnified Parties. No allowed activity faithfully represents these actions.

Section 10.2 requires Customer to pay Fees within 30 days of invoice unless an Order Form provides otherwise; Customer Account fees are automatically charged monthly as specified in the Order Form or order confirmation. Amounts paid are non-refundable, non-cancellable, and non-creditable. These payment terms cannot be modeled as Charge, which refers to charging third parties.

Section 10.3 imposes tax-payment, no-deduction, exemption-certificate, gross-up, and tax-remittance obligations on Customer, with the stated conditions. No allowed activity faithfully represents provider-directed payment or tax remittance.

The Payment Disputes paragraph requires Customer to pay undisputed Fees and, for a good-faith invoice dispute, notify Mistral AI at the specified address within 15 days of invoice issuance with sufficient detail. Payment and notice are not representable by the allowed activities.
